text: Welcome to Beauty Abyssi! Let's scroll down to explore our luxury nail and pedicure treatments.
Filter by Hand nails to browse classic manicures, gel, French tips, and cat-eye art.
Or explore our Pedicures for relaxing foot care and luxury designs.
Have a design from Pinterest or TikTok? We bring any custom nail photo to life!
Let's book Classic Manicure! Simply click 'Book' right on the treatment card.
Classic Manicure is selected. You can combine a Pedicure, or attach custom photo references.
Choose your preferred appointment date on the calendar.
Enter your full name, active phone number, and your village: Kombolcha, Shisha Ber.
Add your shape or polish notes, and tap 'Confirm & Register Online'!
You're officially registered! Tap 'Direct Chat' to message the artist on Telegram. Done!
